newsitem.title: USA: McClatchy to sell 5 community newspapers.
newsitem.headline: McClatchy to sell 5 community newspapers.

text.p: McClatchy Newspapers Inc Friday said it reached an agreement in principle to sell five of its community newspapers by the end of the year.

In a statement, the company said four California newspapers -- The Dispatch, the Free Lance, the Morgan Hill Times and the Amador Ledger Dispatch -- are being sold to Central Valley Publishing, Inc., a newspaper company managed by USMedia Group Inc.
The fifth paper -- the Ellensburg Daily Record in Washington state -- is being purchased by Pioneer Newspapers, Inc of Seattle.
Terms of the sales, handled by the brokerage firm of Dirks, Van Essen & Associates, were not disclosed. The companies hope to close the sales as soon as possible.
